breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: One by one, U.S. civil rights agency dismantles tools to fight discrimination
breaking_news.summary: The EEOC is seeking to overturn rules created decades ago to tackle discrimination in employment. The Trump administration says those rules have led to more discrimination —against white people.

breaking_news.headline: Remote work -- not AI -- has sidelined recent college graduates, research finds
breaking_news.summary: Research from the New York Fed finds that younger college graduates have been sidelined by remote work in recent years, as companies may be reluctant to hire those needing more training and mentoring.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic prepares to sell stock to the public; files preliminary IPO paperwork
breaking_news.summary: The Anthropic IPO, and those of other AI-related firms like OpenAI, could be among the biggest in U.S. history.

breaking_news.headline: US political commentators denied entry to UK by Home Office
breaking_news.summary: The US citizens and left-wing content creators with huge online followings were due to speak at the SXSW London festival and Oxford this week.

breaking_news.headline: Italians bemused by Milan bull mosaic restoration
breaking_news.summary: Italians wondered what had happened to the animal's "lucky-charm" testicles.

breaking_news.headline: Williams, 44, to return to action in Queen's doubles
breaking_news.summary: Serena Williams will return to competitive tennis for the first time in nearly four years when she plays in the women's doubles at Queen's.

breaking_news.headline: Hungarian PM threatens to oust Orbán-era president
breaking_news.summary: Hungary's president has refused Prime Minister Péter Magyar's demands to step aside, setting up a constitutional clash.

breaking_news.headline: Three Ebola vaccines in development amid growing outbreak fears
breaking_news.summary: IAVI, Moderna and the University of Oxford are all working on new vaccines.

breaking_news.headline: Bowen: Trump needs this war to end but Iran is not backing down
breaking_news.summary: Under pressure from the polls and Gulf allies, the White House is pushing for a deal but Iran wants concessions, writes BBC's international editor.

breaking_news.headline: Iran warns Israeli attacks in Lebanon threaten ceasefire with US
breaking_news.summary: Earlier Israel's PM ordered strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs in response to Hezbollah rocket and drone attacks on northern Israel.

breaking_news.headline: Why is Lidl opening a pub?
breaking_news.summary: The debate about about what seems like a bizarre idea of having a cold pint after exploring the store's well known middle aisle.

breaking_news.headline: Put a £5 deposit on vapes to stop fires, say waste companies
breaking_news.summary: The industry body for waste companies says a refundable deposit would help boost vape recycling, but others disagree.

breaking_news.headline: Caribbean hot sauce producers warn of shortages and higher prices
breaking_news.summary: Manufacturers in Jamaica say the key chilli peppers they need are in limited supply.

breaking_news.headline: UK banks blocked from cyber AI tool Mythos get offer from rival OpenAI
breaking_news.summary: Nine banks have been offered access to GPT 5.5 Cyber, as fierce rival Anthropic has blocked previews of its tool.

breaking_news.headline: Abusive passengers could be blacklisted from all airlines under new proposal
breaking_news.summary: The scheme would allow airlines to share information on disruptive passengers and potentially restrict their access to flights.
